Item Class: Tablet
Rarity: Rare
Ancient Mandate
Ritual Tablet
-------------

## Item Level: 79

{ Implicit Modifier }
Adds Ritual Altars to a Map
10 uses remaining
-----------------

{ Prefix Modifier "Crystallised" (Tier: 1) }
Map contains an additional Essence — Unscalable Value
{ Suffix Modifier "of Devotion" (Tier: 1) }
Deferring Favours at Ritual Altars in Map costs 26(30-20)% reduced Tribute
{ Suffix Modifier "of the Dogma" (Tier: 1) }
Rerolling Favours at Ritual Altars in Map costs 21(30-20)% reduced Tribute
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Can be used in a personal Map Device to add modifiers to a Map.
